# Norna

> Norna is an opinionated open source CLI for building responsive websites from Markdown, images and a theme preset.

The canonical user reference is rendered at https://janga.github.io/norna/reference/.
The Markdown links below point to its single authored source on the main branch.
It describes current development, which can be newer than the installed npm
package. For a fixed release, use its Git tag: through v0.7.26 reference sources
are under docs/; later tags use site/pages/032-reference/.

## Learn and compare

- [Getting Started](https://janga.github.io/norna/getting-started/install-norna/)
- [What Norna Does](https://janga.github.io/norna/features/)
- [Examples](https://janga.github.io/norna/examples/)
